changelog.name: Claude Code CHANGELOG (raw)
changelog.purpose: Authoritative source for Claude Code surface-parameter changes (Effort levels, Thinking knobs, slash commands, slider labels, settings.json keys, environment variables). Anthropic ships the canonical changelog per-release in the claude-code repo. Reading the raw GitHub blob bypasses GitHub HTML wrapping and is trivially parseable as Markdown.

model_config_docs.name: Claude Code model-config docs (effort/thinking)
model_config_docs.purpose: Authoritative source for Claude Code Effort levels (the per-model matrix), the ultracode session setting vs the ultrathink per-turn keyword, and the extended-thinking controls. Only the four in-scope sections (#adjust-effort-level, #choose-an-effort-level, #use-ultrathink-for-one-off-deep-reasoning, #extended-thinking) are tracked; the source-hash gate hashes ONLY that span so unrelated docs edits (model aliases, env vars, 1M context, caching) don't trigger a run. The committed snapshot is update/claude-code-effort.json; the offline conformance gate is update/validate_effort_conformance.py.
